text: Psalm 13 For the Music Director. A Psalm of David. How long, O Lord? Will You forget me for good? How long will you hide Your face from me?
How long will I harbor cares in my soul and sorrow in my heart by day? How long will my enemy loom over me?
Take note and answer me, O Lord my God! Brighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,
lest my enemy say, “I have him,” lest my foes exult when I stumble.
I for my part confide in Your kindness; may my heart exult in Your salvation!
I will sing to the Lord, because He has dealt bountifully with me.
